title: Abandoned Attic Nest
description: A dark wooden attic interior filled with a massive tangled pile of dry thorny branches and twigs. Two heavy blue velvet curtains with gold trim hang from the rafters on the left and right, framing the chaotic nest-like accumulation that covers most of the wooden floor.
prompt: dark wooden attic interior viewed from floor level, massive chaotic pile of dry thorny branches and twigs filling the center and foreground, heavy deep blue velvet curtains with golden fringe hanging on both sides from the rafters, exposed wooden beams on the ceiling, dusty wooden floorboards, dim mysterious lighting, eerie and desolate atmosphere, highly detailed textures, cinematic composition
